typography.headline: H1 text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-balance text-foreground. Center alignment solves the empty desktop space.
typography.standfirst: text-base sm:text-lg text-muted-foreground max-w-2xl text-balance mt-4
typography.counter: text-sm font-semibold tabular-nums tnum tracking-tight text-foreground

colors.primary_shift: Eliminate the amber/gold (--accent) entirely. It clashes with the brand red. Use the brand red (--primary) for all interactive and trust elements.
colors.hero_background: Remove `hero-bg` (pink) and `hero-grain`. Use `bg-background` (pure white/dark) for a crisp, authoritative feel.
colors.hero_glow: Add a subtle radial glow behind the hero: `bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-primary/10 via-background to-background`.
colors.chip_colors: Light mode: `bg-primary/5 text-primary border-primary/20`. Dark mode adjusts automatically via variables.

visual enhancers.technical_grid: To add a professional 'fintech/automotive' feel without heavy images, use a pure CSS grid background: `bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,hsl(var(--border))_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(to_bottom,hsl(var(--border))_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:24px_24px] [mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse_60%_50%_at_50%_0%,#000_70%,transparent_100%)]`.
visual enhancers.shadows: Replace generic soft shadows with crisp, layered shadows. Trust strip container: `shadow-[0_2px_10px_-3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]`.

layouts.hero_section: Change from left-aligned to CENTER-ALIGNED (`flex flex-col items-center text-center mx-auto max-w-3xl`). This instantly fixes the 'empty right side' desktop issue and creates a premium, focused search-engine vibe. Padding: `pt-12 pb-8 sm:pt-16 sm:pb-12` (compact enough to keep car cards visible).
layouts.trust_chips: Mobile Fix: To prevent the 3rd pill wrapping awkwardly, use a horizontally scrollable container with hidden scrollbars. `flex flex-row items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto w-full snap-x snap-mandatory [-ms-overflow-style:none] [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden py-1`. Desktop: `justify-center flex-wrap`.
layouts.cta_row: Group CTA and counter. `flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-4 mt-8 w-full sm:w-auto`. The CTA button is `w-full sm:w-auto h-12 px-8 rounded-full`. The counter sits beside (desktop) or below (mobile) with a pulsing live-dot indicator (`size-2 rounded-full bg-green-500 animate-pulse`).
layouts.trust_strip: Major Space-Saver: Abandon the 3 stacked cards. Use a single 'Bento' container. `grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 divide-y sm:divide-y-0 sm:divide-x divide-border bg-card border border-border rounded-xl overflow-hidden w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto`. Inside each cell: `flex flex-row items-center gap-4 p-4 sm:p-5`. The icon sits left, text sits right. This slashes vertical height by 60% on mobile.

grids.trust_strip_grid: 1 column on mobile, 3 columns on tablet/desktop. Direct children of the grid must be the trust items.

motion.css_only: Since `framer-motion` is NOT installed, rely strictly on CSS transitions and keyframes in `index.css`.
motion.entrance_animations: Add to index.css: `@keyframes fadeInUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }`. Apply `.animate-fade-in-up` to Hero elements with staggered animation-delays (0ms for chips, 100ms for H1, 200ms for CTA, 300ms for Trust Strip).
motion.hover_states: CTA: `transition-transform duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:translate-y-0 hover:shadow-lg`. Trust strip cells: `transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure `--primary` text on `primary/10` background meets APCA contrast standards. The red button must have clear white text.
accessibility.screen_readers: The live counter pulse dot should have `aria-hidden="true"`. The horizontal scrolling chips must have accessible focus states.

media.notes: No external images required. We are relying entirely on high-end typography, CSS grid patterns, and Lucide icons to achieve the 'professional' look without risking brand clashing with stock photos.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Update `index.css` to include the `@keyframes fadeInUp` and utility classes for staggering delays.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Rewrite the Hero component. Center all text. Implement the CSS radial gradient and technical background pattern using Tailwind utility classes.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Refactor the trust chips to use `flex overflow-x-auto` to prevent mobile wrap orphans, and change their color from amber to `--primary` variations.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Refactor the Trust Strip component into a single bordered grid with `divide-y` on mobile and `divide-x` on desktop, utilizing inline flex layouts for the icon + text to save vertical space.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Ensure all `data-testid` attributes are intact and visually verify that the car catalogue list will still be visible above the fold on standard mobile screens.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center align standard paragraphs or app containers globally. However, for this specific Hero header, center alignment is requested to resolve desktop layout imbalance. Ensure mobile padding is compact. Use crisp borders (`border-border`) and avoid muddy gray transparencies. Never use `transition: all`. Always respect dark mode variables (`bg-card`, `text-foreground`).
